title: Throne
text: “The dragon under Naofumi’s command had set up a solid defense. It wouldn’t listen to a word I said. I had a hard time convincing it.”
That’s only to be expected. Since Rival holds a grudge against Ren, it would have been a miracle if it had even listened to you in the first place.
“…I won’t accept that, though.”
Itsuki, who had been silent until then, said this with a look of dissatisfaction. Is he still spouting such foolish nonsense? He really is a stubborn one.
“Well… I did capture him alive and keep him imprisoned for a while…”

My father muttered, seeming at a loss for words. Is there something wrong with that? If things had continued as they were, Itsuki was in danger of being eliminated by the Three Heroes Church as an imposter. From that perspective, capturing him alive was the best solution, wasn’t it? He should actually be grateful.
“There’s no way the Three Heroes Church, Mr. Aultcray, or Ms. Marti could be the villains.”
“Then let me tell the truth here to the Bow Hero… Lord Kawasumi. It’s a pleasure to meet you. I am Mirellia Q Melromarc, wife of Aultcray, the true Queen of Melromarc, and mother of Marti and Melty.”
The Queen stood before the throne and declared. The soldiers saluted in unison.
“Where is Trash?”
It’s incredibly unsettling that he isn’t here.
“Didn’t Melty-chan talk him out of it?”

“Um… Father wouldn’t listen to me at all, and while we were arguing, Mother’s personal shadow took him away somewhere… But after that, I declared that the revolution had succeeded and that the Queen would be back soon…”
Her finacée spoke as if at a loss for words.
“Then please bring Aultcray here.”
At the Queen’s command, the soldiers sprang into action, and shortly thereafter, Trash was brought in, his arms held fast. He was putting up a fierce struggle and making quite a commotion.
“Let me go, you insolent wretch! Who do you think I am?!”
“I believe you are the Regent, the second-highest authority in the realm?”
“Oh! Isn’t that my wife! The people of this country have been brainwashed by the Shield and are resorting to such foolish acts as a revolution. Behead the person in charge immediately!”
Even while standing right here, Trash is still issuing orders without learning his lesson. Isn’t he a complete fool?
“Aultcray, where is Malty?”
“M-Malty is…”
Trash is averting his gaze. If it were the Crimson Swine, I would’ve sent him to the afterlife myself. Well, since no one’s watching, there’s really no need to say it out loud.
“I let him escape on my own authority given the circumstances.”
“I see. Then issue a nationwide wanted notice.”
The Queen gave that order to the soldier, and he left immediately. But even if you do that, he won’t be found anymore. Ever.
“What do you mean, what did Malty do?!”

What did he do, you ask? He set a trap for my Father and killed Fleon-chan. It’s an unforgivable atrocity. I killed him this time too, and if the loop happens again, I’ll kill him then as well. Over and over again—as long as the loop continues, I’ll make sure to slaughter him.

“This is punishment for needlessly sowing discord among the Heroes. Furthermore, you’re guilty of conspiring with the Three Heroes Church to oust the nation’s nobles. Be prepared to face the grave consequences of using the Heroes for your own personal gain.”
“That can’t be… but Shield tried to rape Malty!”
“Who would do such a thing!”
My father is furious. Amidst all this, the Queen turns her gaze toward Itsuki.
“Lord Iwatani, a rapist? Excellent! If it means introducing the blood of a Hero into my bloodline, there’s nothing to lose—only to gain.”
“What did you say!? What are you talking about, my wife!”

Exactly. Mixing my Father’s blood with that of a Crimson Swine—a pig so filthy it stands out even among pigs—is an act that defies even the gods. By the way, for me, “God” means Filo-tan. Under no circumstances… what was it again?

“Lord Kawasumi, please listen carefully. This Aultcray attempted to frame Lord Iwatani, the Shield Hero, out of a deeply personal grudge. The Three Heroes Church simply took advantage of such a foolish Aultcray.”

“Ah, that’s certainly true. We’ve witnessed the outrageous acts of the Three Heroes Church ourselves. They’ve repeatedly told me—even while I was active in Zeltoble—to return to the kingdom, and they’ve often interfered with my activities. What’s more, they’re a barbaric bunch who’d try to kill me if I failed.”
Ren is backing up the Queen’s testimony. Still, Ren’s smug look has been really annoying ever since a little while ago.
“As a result, they tried to use you, Lord Kawasumi, through underhanded means to manipulate the kingdom as they pleased.”
“No way… No, that’s not true. You’ve all been brainwashed by Naofumi!”

“‘Brainwashing’ is a convenient term, but please think carefully. The Three Heroes Church is now recognized worldwide as a cult. I’ll give you some time to consider which side is right, so please give it some thought.”

Giving them time to think is a bit naive, isn’t it? Well, if Itsuki were to hear about the Three Heroes Church’s rampage all over the world… might she change her mind? She’d probably stubbornly insist she’s not in the wrong.
“Didn’t you just say something horrifying enough to make my blood run cold?”
“That’s right. The story about how it’d be a godsend if my Father had sex with Crimson Swine and she got pregnant.”
“Ugh… I don’t even want to hear that as a joke, not with a guy like that. Ah… Sorry, Melty-chan.”

“No, it’s fine. If you know my older sister’s true nature… I’m actually wondering why you didn’t make that choice? If you had a child with the Shield Hero, you’d gain Mother’s trust and improve your chances of inheriting the throne.”
“What are you so surprised about, Melty-chan?”
As if snapping back to her senses, my finacée shook her head.
“R-right! I don’t know what my older sister was thinking, and it’s all in the past now!”
The Queen cleared her throat to change the subject.

“Itsuki, maybe we look like the bad guys because you were treated so favorably. But the truth is, the Three Heroes Church, the King, and the Princess were the villains. That’s why we’re here now. By your own logic, evil has been destroyed and justice has triumphed. That’s all there is to it.”
Ren spoke to Itsuki in a tone meant to reason with him. After all, he already knew from when they captured him alive that Itsuki wouldn’t listen to what I or Father had to say.
“Whether it’s a lie or the truth, the Queen has given us time to verify it. Isn’t that enough?”
“But… I’m not evil!”
“…Not realizing you were being used isn’t evil, is it? Just think of it as bad luck.”

Itsuki kept muttering to himself over and over, as if he couldn’t accept the reality that he’d been complicit in evil. Just then, that stalker pig and his cronies seemed to rush over and start trying to persuade Itsuki.
“That’s it, isn’t it? They’re trying to worm their way into the cracks of his heart to gain his trust.”
“Motoyasu, just be quiet for a moment, will you?”
“Understood.”
Since Father told me off, I’ll keep quiet.
“Grrr! I—I won’t accept it! It was the Shield that incited the people and brainwashed our nation!”

“Still spouting such nonsense… The time has come for Melromarc to be reborn through reform. Those who enslave Demi-Humans, torment them, and revel in their suffering are no longer needed in this country.”
“No! I cannot accept that!”
“Aultcray, whether you admit it or not, the outcome won’t change. Your authority has already been shattered.”

The queen bowed her head to her Father, then took his hand. She then led him, along with her Finacée, toward the throne. Her Father tilted his head in confusion as the queen led him away… and he was seated on the throne. She even had her Finacée sit on his lap.
“W-What are you doing, wife!”
“What am I doing, you ask? I’m simply having Lord Iwatani, the Shield Hero, sit on the throne as the representative of our nation.”
“Huh? Huh? Huh?”

Her Father looked around at us with an expression that said, “How did this happen?” Her Finacée, her face bright red, sat on her Father’s lap, looking utterly bewildered. What on earth is going on here?
